author: Retro Game Corps
description:
I love streaming games from my PC to a handheld; it allows me to play more demanding games on the go. This video is a comprehensive guide on how to set up a number of different options, including apps like Apollo, Artemis, Sunshine, and Moonlight.

Streaming apps:
Apollo: https://github.com/ClassicOldSong/Apollo
Artemis: https://github.com/ClassicOldSong/moonlight-android
Sunshine: https://github.com/lizardbyte/sunshine
Moonlight: https://app.lizardbyte.dev/Sunshine/
Steam Link: https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay
Duo: https://github.com/DuoStream/Duo
Razer Remote Play: https://www.razer.com/gaming-software/razer-pc-remote-play

My favorite handhelds for streaming:
AYN Odin 3: https://youtu.be/AEmThOmbWEo
AYN Odin 2 Portal: https://youtu.be/DTCGlq3gBTM
Mangmi Pocket Max: https://youtu.be/zDlPCjdOaCM
Retroid Pocke Flip 2: https://youtu.be/6LIZWnD-62Q
RP Flip 2 grips: https://www.etsy.com/listing/4299735809/retroid-pocket-flip-2-grip-ergonomic-3d
